integrity: Universal claims are justified by the written structural and counting proof; the included finite verifier is corroborative rather than proof of all parameter cases.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary undirected K_m Cartesian C_n, m,n>=3, capacity one; minimum-size sets only. Does not classify nonminimum 1-limited dominating sets, other capacities or general products. Historical novelty is provisional; independent review absent.
title: Exact 1-limited domination and all minimizers of clique–cycle Cartesian products
